finding: All six F-AHL10 extreme-regime fidelity failures are conductivity-lookup dominated under the frozen attribution design. Restoring exact K makes every failed case pass while retaining the derivative-consistent theta/C interpolant. Restoring exact theta/C while retaining lookup K does not resolve any of the six failures.
design_implication: Do not globally refine the retention/capacity interpolant. Decouple support selection: retain compact derivative-consistent theta/C support and construct a separate adaptive conductivity representation with its own error target.
nonclaims: The result does not establish the required K error tolerance.
It does not establish the best K interpolation family.
